Class MainWindowController

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.MainWindowController
@Component @Scope("prototype") public class MainWindowController extends Object
The window, and the one screen in it: the header, which stands in for the system's title bar; the sidebar, with the status filters and their counts, always in view, and the keyboard shortcuts; and the task list, with its heading, the search, and the notice a task that has gone is reported in. Dialogs open over it all, on a layer of their own.

Everything goes through TaskService. After each change the screen reads the list and the counts again, so what it shows is what is saved, a second copy of the app's changes included once it is refreshed.

Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan
